name: Tata Group
monetization: Indian conglomerate (Tata Sons holding; TCS listed) whose TCS HyperVault unit sells AI-ready data-center capacity — OpenAI is the anchor customer, starting at 100MW with ambitions toward 1GW.
description_md: Tata Group spans IT services (Tata Consultancy Services), steel, autos, power, and consumer businesses. Its relevance to the AI money map is TCS's HyperVault data-center business, launched with OpenAI as its first customer (announced Feb 19, 2026 at the India AI Impact Summit) as part of OpenAI's Stargate-branded India buildout. The deal also puts ChatGPT Enterprise across Tata's workforce.

observations.metric_label: TCS HyperVault initial AI DC capacity for OpenAI
observations.notes: Initial 100MW for OpenAI, with a stated path to scale to 1GW. Contract dollars undisclosed.
